title: gravitas.instructor-expectations/2
description: What an author checks a lesson's expected answers against, in js/data/instructorExpectations.js: for each lesson id, the expected-answer text of each step, keyed by the step's sid. Version 1 keyed the text by step number; js/instructorExpectations.js readExpectations() reads it by looking the number up in the lesson's steps and drops, with a note, a step that is gone. A record of a newer version is refused in words (readVersioned). Not imported by any route: the answer-key PDF and the author check read it. FORMATS.md lists it.
